blocks.text: Ethical (sahi usoolon wali) research is liye aham hai ke is se nateeje (findings) bharose ke qabil hote hain aur research se jude logon ke rights (haq) ki izzat hoti hai. Ethical guidelines par chal kar researchers nuqsan pohanchane, ghalat maloomat (misinformation) phailane, ya jin logon ya communities (groups) ki study karte hain un se na-insafi karne se bach jate hain. Ethical research nateeje ki credibility (saakh) aur reliability barhati hai, ta ke research doosron ke liye qeemti ho.

Misal: agar aap data ghadh lein (falsify karein, yani jhoota data bana lein) ya kisi aur ka kaam usay credit diye baghair copy kar lein (plagiarism), to yeh unethical (ghalat aur be-imaani wala) hai. Is se na sirf ghalat nateeje nikal sakte hain balki researcher ke taur par aap ki saakh (reputation) bhi kharab hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Research ethics nateeje ki credibility aur reliability ke liye kyun aham hain? Unethical tareeqe research community aur society par kya asar dalte hain? (Long question 4)
blocks.explanation: Ethics se nateeje bharose ke qabil bante hain: sacha data, sources ka credit aur insaf wala analysis doosron ko nateeje par bharosa karne aur un par aage kaam karne deta hai; ijazat (consent) aur raazdari participants ko bachati hai. Unethical tareeqe, jaise data ghadhna, plagiarism ya bina ijazat data lena, ghalat nateeje dete hain; doosre researchers in ghalat nateeje par kaam kar ke waqt aur paisa zaya karte hain; logon ka research par bharosa kam hota hai; aur agar sehat ya policy ke faisle in par hon to society ko nuqsan pohanch sakta hai. Researcher ki apni saakh bhi kharab hoti hai (kitab ki misal).

items: Ethical research: bharose wale nateeje aur logon ke rights ki izzat.
Data ghadhna aur plagiarism unethical hain: ghalat nateeje aur saakh ka nuqsan.
